verdict.rationale: 1Password markets a 'Connect Server' that can be deployed in a company's own infrastructure to access items via REST API (docs-4), which sounds like partial self-hosting, but this is only a caching/access layer in front of 1Password's cloud vaults, not a full self-hosted sync server. Community evidence directly contradicts the idea that secrets can stay entirely within an admin's perimeter: users note 1Password has 'no local vault storage' anymore and ask the vendor to 'continue support for local, non-cloud-based vault files' (comm-7, comm-8), confirming that the cloud remains the source of truth. Missing for 10: any documented on-prem deployment of the full sync/vault backend, migration guide for self-hosted secret storage, or evidence that Connect Server operates without 1Password's cloud.
